174template <size_t b>
175std::vector<LabelType> decodeBrick(const CompressedBrick &brick, size_t targetLOD)
176{
177 constexpr size_t levels = Brick<b>::Levels;
178 const size_t outCount = Utils::sizeForLevel<b>(targetLOD);
179 std::vector<LabelType> out(outCount, EMPTY_VALUE);
180
181 size_t ip = 0; // palette read index
182 size_t bytePos = 0;
183
184 out[0] = brick.palette[ip];
185
186 bool highNibbleNext = false;
187
188 for (size_t l = 0; l < levels - 1; ++l)
189 {
190 const size_t nodeCount = sizeForLevel<b>(l);
191 for (size_t mortonIdx = 0; mortonIdx < nodeCount; ++mortonIdx)
192 {
193 size_t i = coarseNodeToOutputIndex(mortonIdx, l, targetLOD);
194 // i points to first voxel in out[] corresponding to this coarse node
195
196 // compute children indices of current node
197 auto childrenMortonIndices = computeChildMortonIndices(mortonIdx);
198
199 auto lastChildOfI = coarseNodeToOutputIndex(childrenMortonIndices[7], l + 1, targetLOD);
200 if (out[lastChildOfI] != EMPTY_VALUE)
201 continue;
202
203 LabelType parent = out[i]; // store parent label
204
205 for (size_t childMortonIdx : childrenMortonIndices)
206 {
207 size_t j = coarseNodeToOutputIndex(childMortonIdx, l + 1, targetLOD);
208 auto [op, stop, delta] = readNextOperationAndStopBit(brick.encodedData, bytePos, highNibbleNext);
209
210 LabelType val = EMPTY_VALUE;
211
212 switch (op)
213 {
214 case OpType::ParentReuse:
215 val = parent;
216 break;
217 case OpType::NeighborX:
218 case OpType::NeighborY:
219 case OpType::NeighborZ:
220 val = getNeighborValue(out, l, childMortonIdx, op, targetLOD);
221 break;
222 case OpType::PaletteAdvance:
223 val = brick.palette[++ip];
224 break;
225 case OpType::PaletteBack0:
226 val = brick.palette[ip];
227 break;
228 case OpType::PaletteBackD:
229 val = brick.palette[ip - delta - 1];
230 break;
231 }
232
233 out[j] = val;
234
235 if (stop)
236 fillSubBlock(childMortonIdx, l + 1, targetLOD, val, out);
237 }
238 }
239 }
240
241 return out;
242}
